Oh? You want to know about yourself?
I'm not sure if your mother would get me in trouble for telling you too much.
Yikes. Firestar is no fun cat to talk about.
He was born a rogue and taken into BrambleClan.
His name was Firewing, and he acted out from the start.
He secretly founded and led a group beneath Bramblestar's eyes and started a rebellion against the Clan.
He named his group FireClan and marched out to the west where he laid down camp.
FireClan has been there ever since, and their warriors are as violent as ever.

Heatherkit was stillborn, but your mother insisted on naming her still.

Ashtail is an interesting she-cat.
She recently joined BrambleClan as a rogue, and has been trying her best to fit in since then.
She's pretty confused about everything still, but once you tell her to do something, she does it right.
She's a sweetheart and helps convince Bramblestar of better consequences when rogue issues occur.
Liontail is the oldest cat of us all.
He was one of our founders.
He, Shallowstripe, his kits, and Bramblestar met up and settled in this camp and set up everything we know today.
Bramblestar had Clan experience while Liontail was the bridge to the growth of rogues in the Clan.
Without him, BrambleClan would be much smaller.
But he had also brought his son Firewing into the Clan.
Webbedfoot was a good warrior.
He was Sparrowtail's mate until he was attacked by a fox.
His injuries sent him to the elders' den, and he was unable to care for his daughter.
He'll be with us for a long time now, but he'll really need some company once Liontail passes away.
Ah. I remember when Milkywillow had just become a full medicine cat when she realized she was expecting.
Oakshine had disappeared, Badgerface had died, and she was under all this stress when her kit was about to be born.
Incredibly, she has been able to balance her motherhood with helping us, especially since her mate had left her to join FireClan.
Goldenstrike is Milkywillow's daughter.
She is one of the most beautiful she-cats I have ever seen, but she has been devastated ever since her father left.
